instances._translation_comment: The five UN target locales beside the English source, all UNOFFICIAL: agent drafts with no human sign-off (owner, 2026-11-18, option A: 'Turn on translation for litlfred/smart-ra'). officialOnly false renders unofficial text with the platform's unverified banner. Nothing here is official; only a person's sign-off (human-translation-workflow) makes a catalogue official.
instances._site_comment: `extends: document-folio` (folio-assistant-core templates/site-presets/, on cat-harness-tools folio-base) runs the steps every document folio runs: document, library, review-sheet, glossary, bibliography, archimate and context, with links: refuse, so no step can be dropped again (smart-ra#48, #91; cat-harness-tools#2345). This site adds the public-comment dashboard, the RA mapper and the old-address forwarders after them, and keeps its own site:document script (--link-terms, --bibliography-url), which wins over the preset's command.

ig._comment: What this repository's FHIR IG side is, per the content types its layers register (bean folio-assistant-cz17, follow-up b; owner card 2026-10-30T12:40Z, "A. ig section in index.config"). `ig`: fhir-harness's `ig` content type (fhir-harness#198); `include` is everything fhir-harness's IG readers read in this repository, and nothing else is read (owner, 2026-10-30: "harness desclares what it it pays attention to in the repo"). It lists every `input/` entry the build used before the section existed, so nothing is dropped. The folio (`folio/`, `review/`, `library/`, `archimate/`, `documents/`, `uploads/`) is the `dpi-h-ra` document instance's, read by its own adapter and site steps, not by this list. sushi-config.yaml stays SUSHI's file. smart-immunizations#89 is the model.
